name: wispr-for-builders
description: Wispr for Builders, Pack 1: Claude Code mods made for Wispr Flow. Say it, and your Mac does it. Unofficial; not affiliated with Wispr.

plugins.name: wispr-bridge
plugins.description: The harness the other mods share: routes a dictated request to the right mod and shows choices as a small numbered card you answer by voice, keys or click.

plugins.name: wispr-file
plugins.description: Find any file on your Mac by voice. Pick from thumbnails by saying "two"; it pastes, reveals, opens or copies it. Spotlight runs locally.

plugins.name: wispr-wish
plugins.description: Say what you want done to a file: "make this a PDF", "compress this video for WhatsApp", "transcribe this". Plus tiny apps on request: timer, bill split, QR.

plugins.name: wispr-review
plugins.description: Review any website by voice. A Chrome extension pins each dictated note to the element under your cursor; Claude reads the notes and fixes them.

plugins.name: wispr-pm
plugins.description: Task boards by voice: "park this for the portfolio", "what's next", "split this into tasks", "what's waiting on me".

plugins.name: wispr-guru
plugins.description: A second cursor for Claude. It points at the control you need and walks you through it; answer "done", "next" or "wait, where?".

plugins.name: wispr-video
plugins.description: A voice-first video editor: a teleprompter that follows your voice, word-timed captions, and edits you say out loud. Exports 9:16, 4:5 and 16:9.
